title: Verify registration with valid information
description: Verify that a new visitor can create a SkillBank account using a valid name, email and password.
precondition: The registration page is reachable and the email is not already in the users table.
dependencies: Registration module, MySQL database, Chrome browser, PHP local server
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter valid name, email and password.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Account is created, the user is logged in automatically and the dashboard shows the welcome message with a starting balance of 3 credits.
actual: Account created. Redirected to the dashboard with the message "Welcome to SkillBank! You start with 3 credits." and a credit balance of 3.

title: Verify registration with an empty Name field
description: Verify that registration is rejected when the Name field is left blank.
precondition: The registration page is reachable.
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Leave Name blank, enter a valid email and password.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails and the validation message "Name is required." is displayed.
actual: Registration blocked. Error message displayed: "Name is required."

shots.caption: Validation error returned by the server

title: Verify registration with an empty Email field
description: Verify that registration is rejected when the Email field is left blank.
precondition: The registration page is reachable.
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter a name and password but leave Email blank.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails and the validation message "Email is required." is displayed.
actual: Registration blocked. Error message displayed: "Email is required."

shots.caption: Validation error returned by the server

title: Verify registration with a password shorter than 6 characters
description: Verify that the minimum password length rule is enforced.
precondition: The registration page is reachable.
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter a valid name and email with a 3-character password.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails and the message "Password must be at least 6 characters." is displayed.
actual: Registration blocked. Error message displayed: "Password must be at least 6 characters."

title: Verify registration with an already registered email
description: Verify that the system prevents two accounts from sharing one email address.
precondition: The email ayesha@skillbank.test already exists in the users table.
dependencies: Registration module, MySQL database, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter a new name with an email that is already registered.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails and the message "That email is already registered." is displayed.
actual: Registration blocked. Error message displayed: "That email is already registered."

title: Verify registration with all fields left empty
description: Verify that submitting a completely empty registration form returns every validation message at once.
precondition: The registration page is reachable.
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Leave every field blank.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails and all three validation messages (name, email, password) are displayed together.
actual: Registration blocked. Three errors displayed: Name is required. Email is required. Password must be at least 6 characters.

title: Verify registration with an invalid email format
description: Verify that the browser blocks submission when the email address has no @ symbol.
precondition: The registration page is reachable and the email input is type="email".
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser (HTML5 validation)
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter an email address without the @ symbol.
3. Click Create account.
expected: The form is not submitted and the browser reports an invalid-email validation message; the page stays on /register.
actual: Form was not submitted. Chrome reported the validation message: "Please include an '@' in the email address. 'rifatgmail.com' is missing an '@'." and the page stayed on /register.

shots.caption: Form not submitted - page is still the registration page

title: Verify registration with a password of exactly 6 characters
description: Boundary value test: 6 characters is the smallest accepted password.
precondition: The registration page is reachable and the email is unused.
dependencies: Registration module, MySQL database, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter valid details with a 6-character password.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration succeeds and the user is taken to the dashboard.
actual: Registration successful with a 6-character password; dashboard displayed.

title: Verify registration with a password of exactly 5 characters
description: Boundary value test: 5 characters is one below the minimum and must be rejected.
precondition: The registration page is reachable.
dependencies: Registration module, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page.
2. Enter valid details with a 5-character password.
3. Click Create account.
expected: Registration fails with the message "Password must be at least 6 characters."
actual: Registration blocked at the boundary. Error message displayed: "Password must be at least 6 characters."

title: Verify a new member receives the 3 starting credits
description: Verify that the time-credit rule gives every new account a balance of 3 credits.
precondition: The registration page is reachable and the email is unused.
dependencies: Registration module, MySQL database, Chrome browser
steps: 1. Open the Registration page and register a new member.
2. Click Create account.
3. Read the credit balance from the page and from the database.
expected: The navigation bar and the dashboard both show a credit balance of 3, and the users table stores credits = 3.
actual: Navigation shows "Credits: 3", the dashboard shows "Credit balance: 3" and the users table stores credits = 3.

shots.caption: Dashboard showing the starting credit balance

title: Verify completing a session transfers exactly one credit

dependencies: Session module, credit transfer transaction, MySQL database, Chrome browser

2. Log in as the teacher and open the dashboard.
3. Click "Mark completed (+1)".
expected: The learner's balance drops by 1, the teacher's balance rises by 1 and a row is written to the transactions table.
actual: Session completed. Learner balance 3 -> 2, teacher balance 3 -> 4, and 1 row(s) recorded in the transactions table.
